about: Draft tournament balance. One row per Overtime perk and stat card: its power, the field win-rate gain the AI vs AI simulator measures when it's added alone to a fresh player (tools/draft.py power writes these rows). A draft option is a team plus `perks` perks (`theme_perks` of them in the team's element when there are enough) and `cards` stat cards, redrawn until the summed power is within `band` of `target`. tools/draft.py check deals drafts the same way and plays each option in the simulator. Generates Draft in src/Generated/Sheets.g.cs.

columns.power: field win-rate gain when added alone (simulator)
columns.verified: the simulator run that measured it
